title: lepionurus javanicus
intro: Lepionurus javanicus, commonly known as Java fern, is a type of flowering plant native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially aiding in the treatment of various health conditions such as arthritis and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Java fern include its ability to modulate the immune system and its potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Lepionurus javanicus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
